cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

mechanism: A copies a practice without understanding it, then defends each minimal adjustment as full compliance with the agreement.
confusable: D41 calls work complete; D47 relies on the narrow wording of an actual request.
comparison: Loading a vehicle versus repeated holiday plant care.
seedUse: Use revised requests as escalation but avoid unforeseen sofa and arbitrary can sizes.
